measured.on: the SAP sandbox, through throwaway ABAP Unit probes in a temporary package: JOB_OPEN, SUBMIT VIA JOB of a report that WAITs p_sec seconds, JOB_CLOSE with SDLSTRTDT/TM one hour ahead (or STRTIMMED, or PRED_JOBNAME/PRED_JOBCOUNT), then COMMIT WORK, BP_JOB_DELETE and ROLLBACK WORK in one program run, with TBTCO/TBTCP read after each; a sentinel table written in the caller's LUW; the probes, the report, the table, the package and every job deleted afterwards

schema.EXPECT: A4H = measured on the sandbox; 'unmeasured: assumption' = chosen here, with the reasoning in 'assumption'
schema.steps: run in order. {"step": [...]} is one dialog step (one program run) with these operations in order; any other entry runs between steps
schema.close: JOB_OPEN + JOB_SUBMIT + JOB_CLOSE of job <name>: start = seconds ahead (SDLSTRTDT/TM), immediate = STRTIMMED, after = predecessor job <name>
schema.sentinel: JOB_OPEN of job <name>, used as a pending write of the caller (the sandbox used an INSERT into a throwaway table)
schema.delete: BP_JOB_DELETE of job <name>; commitmode given = COMMITMODE; expect = 0 or the classic exception
schema.drain: one scheduler pass: import the committed outbox, release due jobs, run what is queued
schema.advance: move the clock <seconds>, firing the scheduler's timers
schema.status: per job, its state after the step: P/S/Y/R/F/A from SHOW_JOBSTATE, or none when the job does not exist (TBTCO has no row)
schema.ran: per job, how many times its report ran
schema.blocked: measured, not reproduced here yet: the anomaly that blocks it; the test is pending

cases.title: scheduled, committed and deleted in the same run: deleted at once, a ROLLBACK does not bring it back, it never runs
cases.observed: S before the delete; after it TBTCO and TBTCP have no row; the second delete raises JOB_DOES_NOT_EXIST with BT 127

cases.title: closed and deleted before any COMMIT WORK: rc 0, and gone after a ROLLBACK
cases.observed: on the sandbox the job was already S before the delete, because JOB_OPEN and JOB_CLOSE commit (ANORMALIES.md, job-open-commits)

cases.title: BP_JOB_DELETE with the default COMMITMODE commits the caller's LUW: a pending write survives a later ROLLBACK
with COMMITMODE = space the delete is part of the caller's LUW: a ROLLBACK brings the job back, waiting
cases.blocked: ANOMALY-2026-10-02-fm-is-supplied: an omitted COMMITMODE cannot be told from a space, so the facade always commits; the case runs once the transpiler applies FM defaults

cases.title: a job released to start at once is Y from JOB_CLOSE on, and BP_JOB_DELETE refuses it like a running one, committed or not
cases.observed: on the sandbox the job was Y and then R at the delete (BT 128); here it is still in the outbox and is refused the same

cases.title: a job waiting for its predecessor (S) and the predecessor itself are both deleted at once after the COMMIT
cases.observed: the sandbox closed H without PREDJOB_CHECKSTAT; the local facade requires it = 'X' (ANORMALIES.md, job-standard-facade), so the test passes it

cases.title: a job only opened (P, no step) is deleted
cases.observed: on the sandbox the opened job had survived a ROLLBACK first (JOB_OPEN commits); its delete answered rc 0

cases.title: a finished job is deleted; an unknown one raises JOB_DOES_NOT_EXIST, a missing count JOBCOUNT_MISSING
cases.observed: a running job (R) is refused with JOB_IS_ALREADY_RUNNING (BT 128) and deleted with rc 0 once it is F; here a running job holds the one work process, so nothing can call BP_JOB_DELETE meanwhile

unmeasured: a job waiting for a named event, still in the outbox: deleted like a timed one (it is S on a system and its imported form is already deletable)
BP_JOB_DELETE of an imported job with COMMITMODE = space followed by a ROLLBACK: the operations run stays deleted here (the sandbox brings the job back)
